title: CISS v0.5.0 compatibility schema
description: Project compatibility extension for the supplied partial v0.5 records; not a claim of an externally supplied canonical schema.

related_papers.description: Link papers whose methods are 'as described in ref. X'. Never copy their values; link instead.

length.description: DEPRECATED (v0.4.0): use molecule.geometry.n_units. bp for dsDNA, nt for ssDNA, residues for peptides; rings for helicenes

helix_handedness.description: right/left/mixed. One value per sample_id; an enantiomer pair = two samples linked by chirality_counterpart_of.

stereo_descriptor.description: label as written in the paper: M/P (helicenes), D/L (amino acids, DNA), R/S. Keep alongside helix_handedness so the mapping is auditable (e.g. M = left-handed). Structured locations/counts go in chiral_elements.

chirality_counterpart_of.description: sample_id of the opposite-handedness counterpart measured in this paper; null if only one handedness was studied

enantiomeric_purity.description: ee in % or the paper's wording, e.g. 'enantiopure (chiral HPLC)'

helix_form.description: DEPRECATED (v0.4.0): use molecule.geometry.helix_form. A/B/Z for DNA; alpha/3_10 for peptides

helix_axis_orientation.description: helix axis relative to the substrate. Needed to relate spin_component (defined vs electron momentum / surface normal) to the helix axis.

n_helices.description: DEPRECATED (v0.4.0): use molecule.geometry.n_helices. number of helical segments, e.g. 7 transmembrane alpha-helices in bacteriorhodopsin

host_matrix.description: environment the chiral molecule sits in, e.g. native purple membrane (lipids); null if none

chiral_volume_fraction.description: fraction of the layer volume that is the chiral molecule (bR ~10% of purple membrane)

geometry.description: Shape of the chiral unit as used in this sample. Store what the paper gives; do not convert diameter<->radius or compute pitch/radius here (use derived_quantities).

n_units.description: size in repeat units: bp (dsDNA/dsPNA), nt (ssDNA), residues (peptides), rings (helicenes)

axial_length.description: physical length along the helix axis, nm

pitch.description: rise per full helical turn, nm/turn

units_per_turn.description: repeat units per turn, e.g. bp/turn, residues/turn

rise_per_unit.description: axial rise per repeat unit, nm/unit

diameter.description: helix diameter, nm; say which diameter in diameter_definition

diameter_definition.description: atom_specific = e.g. P-P distance; give the atom in diameter.note

helical_turns.description: number of turns in the molecule (= n_units / units_per_turn if derived)

helix_form.description: A/B/Z for DNA; P-type for PNA; alpha/3_10 for peptides

n_helices.description: number of helical segments, e.g. 7 TM helices in bacteriorhodopsin

strands.description: one entry per physical strand; a nicked strand = several entries sharing segment_of

chirality_origin.description: inherent_monomers = every monomer chiral (DNA sugars, L-amino acids); induced_by_seeds = achiral backbone with chiral end groups; inherent_and_seeds = some chiral monomers plus seeds (γPNA-PNA); inherent_skeleton = helicenes

work_function.description: of the molecule-covered sample if reported

surface_oxide.description: native or thermal oxide on the metal (changes injection/tunneling)

soc_strength.description: spin-orbit coupling value of the substrate metal AS QUOTED in the paper (eV); prefer a shared constants table for values not in the paper

molecular_orientation.description: free text, e.g. 'three proximal rings parallel to surface'

coverage_regime.description: full_coverage = surface completely covered, number of layers not specified

method.description: CD, VCD, absorbance, AFM, LEED, XPS, ...

observable_definition.description: What exactly the reported number is. Required so that values from different techniques are never merged blindly.

spin_reference_axis.description: physical axis the component is defined against, e.g. 'electron momentum = surface normal (normal emission)'

helicity_convention.description: viewpoint defining cw/ccw; often not reported

sherman_function.description: S_eff WITH sign as given; if the paper gives only a magnitude (e.g. '18%') store the magnitude and say so in note

component_measured.description: component analysed AT THE DETECTOR. May differ from observable_definition.spin_component, e.g. longitudinal P_z rotated into transverse by a 90 deg electrostatic bender before the Mott target.

apparatus_id.description: shared id for the same instrument across papers, e.g. muenster_mott

setups.description: v0.3.0 scope: photoemission spin-polarization setups. Electrochemistry / transport setups are out of scope (see gap_schema.json G01-G03, G05).

value_max.description: upper bound when value is a range

sign.description: for results stated only by sign or as 'essentially zero'; value may stay null

duplicate_of.description: same data reported elsewhere (e.g. rounded in main text)

check.description: how validate_ciss.py recomputes value from the result values of `from` (difference = from[0] - from[1]; mean = average of all; ratio_from_P = (1+|P|)/(1-|P|) of from[0])

theory_results.description: calculations reported in the same paper (DFT, model Hamiltonians); kept separate from measurements

method.description: e.g. DFT (SIESTA, PBE, SOC); tight-binding model Hamiltonian

theory_mapping.description: model-ready view: which extracted fields map to which model parameter

spin_component_quantity.description: Direction of the reported spin polarization. longitudinal = parallel/antiparallel to the electron momentum (P_z for normal emission); transverse = perpendicular to the momentum (state which axis in spin_reference_axis); out_of_plane_magnetization / in_plane_magnetization = transport techniques (mc-AFM, Hall, spin valve, magnetic electrode) where the spin axis is set by a ferromagnet magnetized normal to / within the substrate plane; not_spin_resolved = the observable carries no spin direction (e.g. total yield ratio).

axis_orientation_quantity.description: Orientation of an axis (helix axis or magnetization) relative to the substrate plane.

handedness_quantity.description: Helical handedness as a controlled category, not free text. 'mixed' = racemic / both-handed mixture; 'unknown' = paper does not say and cannot be inferred.

value_max.description: upper bound when value is a range

sign.description: for results stated only by sign or as 'essentially zero'; value may stay null

value_basis.description: Where a structural number physically comes from (orthogonal to status, which says how it was extracted).

geometry_quantity.description: quantity + basis. basis_reference names the proxy/literature system (e.g. 'dsγPNA homoduplex, NMR (ref 36)').

strand_id.description: name as in the paper, e.g. PNA1

polymer_type.description: backbone family; backbone modifications go in chiral_elements / modifications

direction.description: reading direction of `sequence`. DNA/RNA -> 5to3; PNA/peptide -> N_to_C

sequence.description: monomer one-letter codes only, no spaces/terminal groups; null if not given (e.g. protein -> structure_db_id)

terminus_start.description: group at 5'/N end as written, e.g. 'H-Lys-', 'Ac-'

terminus_end.description: group at 3'/C end as written, e.g. '-Lys3-NH2', '-(CH2)3SH'

segment_of.description: logical strand this piece belongs to when a strand is nicked (e.g. 'complement')

segment_order.description: 1-based order along segment_of in this strand's direction

carries_anchor.description: true if molecule.anchor is on this strand

positions.description: 1-based monomer positions in that strand's direction; empty for terminal groups

induced_handedness.description: handedness this element favours on its own

dominant.description: true if the paper says this element wins when elements conflict
